findings.explanation: Payment is due ninety days from the effective date, which exposes you to cash flow delays exceeding acceptable terms.
findings.suggested_change: The Client shall pay all undisputed invoices within thirty (30) days of receipt.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, I hope you are having a good week. I am looking forward to getting started, but I would like to request a few adjustments to the agreement before signing. - Regarding the clause stating '$ 115,250.00 Net ninety (90) days from the Effective Date of this Agreement.', waiting ninety days for payment creates cash flow difficulties; I propose changing this so that the client pays all undisputed invoices within thirty days of receipt. Thank you for understanding, and I look forward to finalizing this soon. Best regards.
